_comment: Curated user-facing notes keyed by deal id. No commission, payout, or internal data here (that lives in the private tracker). Never invent promo codes.
deal-scraperapi-001: Free-tier trap: 7-day trial (5,000 API credits, no card) then a free plan (1,000 credits / 5 concurrent); paid plans start around $49/mo once you outgrow free.
deal-postmark-001: Postmark also has a Free Developer plan (100 emails/mo, no card). Use the free tier for light transactional mail; paid plans when you need volume.
deal-postmark-free-001: 100 emails/mo forever is fine for light transactional mail — not cold outreach.
deal-firecrawl-001: Firecrawl also lists a public free tier (1,000 credits/mo) and a student program. Use those when they fit.
deal-firecrawl-free-001: Monthly free credits can cover light crawl jobs; heavier volume needs a paid plan.
deal-firecrawl-student-001: Application required — not a redeemable promo code. Student eligibility is vendor-gated.
deal-scrapedo-001: Free signup exists, but meaningful scrape volume is on paid Hobby/Pro/Business plans.
deal-scrapingdog-001: Free signup exists; production scrape volume is on paid plans. No promo code on this listing.
deal-runpod-001: RunPod's referral program can give the new user signup credit after adding $10; confirm current terms on runpod.io before relying on it.
